# LoveToDate

> LoveToDate is a UK dating platform where browsing, likes, and AI compatibility insights are free — you only pay when you find someone you'd genuinely love to date.

LoveToDate uses an advanced AI engine to score compatibility across 15+ dimensions (values, lifestyle, goals, personality, interests). Users can see who liked them and view full profiles before deciding to unlock messaging. Hybrid monetization: free discovery, pay-per-connection or subscription.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of LoveToDate, how it works, and AI-powered matching.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on modern dating, relationships, and the LoveToDate journey.
- [Dating Advice](/dating-advice): Expert tips on dating, communication, and building healthy relationships.
- [Testimonials](/testimonials): Real success stories from LoveToDate members.
- [Conversation Starters](/conversation-starters): AI-generated icebreakers and conversation prompts.
- [Fun Stuff](/fun): Turn-based games members play together to discover compatibility.
- [Subscription](/subscription): Pricing plans and premium features.
